title: CNTrafficSymbols Core
body:
This is the core module and dependency of “CNTrafficSymbols” series mods. This mod itself does not add any blocks or items; it provides some structural block classes and block properties enum classes.

## Supported Minecraft & Modloader Versions
Currently this mod supports Fabric loader only; it supports the latest Minecraft release and Minecraft 1.20.4(LTS).
